# Conflux change checklist

- [ ] Existing architecture, package guidance, and relevant ADRs inspected.
- [ ] Technical specification or decision record updated where needed.
- [ ] Principal Context and provenance impact assessed.
- [ ] Allowed, denied, mixed-context, failure, and immutability cases tested where applicable.
- [ ] Unit, integration, adapter, benchmark, or reproducibility tests added as appropriate.
- [ ] Full validation and focused checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation, glossary, roadmap, and implementation status updated.
- [ ] Paper notes and terminology synchronised if architecture changed.
- [ ] Diff reviewed for hidden trust assumptions, benchmark-specific logic, and permission broadening.
